title: Does not fit twist top caps
text:
Does not fit twist top caps. I bought this to help break the airtight seal on twist off caps, such as tomato sauce. It’s not deep enough. If you position the lift-bar under the edge of the cap, the top of the tool is not high enough to reach the top, so you have no leverage to break the section seal.
Tossed it in the trash
